eyebrow: A place for the people who matter
heroDescription: Connect generations, keep memories, and remember meaningful dates. A personal space for the people who make your life.
heroNote: Start with someone you love. Keep a whole story.
photoAlt: Several generations of a family looking at old photographs together beside an open window.
familyDescription: Begin with familiar names. Connect parents, grandparents, and children to see your family's journey across generations.
familyPointOneDescription: Discover your roots and the relationships that make a family.
familyPointTwo: Know your people a little better
familyPointTwoDescription: A familiar face, a milestone, a story worth keeping.
treeCaption: A small branch of a much bigger story
memoriesTitle: Some days deserve to stay with us.
memoriesDescription: Milestones, gatherings, and old photographs. The little things that become your family's shared memory.
timelineDescription: Bring your family's milestones together into one unfolding story.
timelineEventOne: The day we found a home together
timelineEventTwo: A new arrival in the family
anniversaryTitle: A date to remember. A person to love.
anniversaryDescription: Keep meaningful dates close, so there is always a reason to return and reconnect.
libraryTitle: Sometimes, a photograph says it all.
libraryDescription: Bring photos into albums, add a few words and a date. So years from now, your family can still remember the story behind them.
gardenAlt: A grandmother and granddaughter walking hand in hand through a sunlit countryside garden.
mapDescription: Some people live nearby, others have travelled far. Familiar places connect your family to each other, and to the memories made along the way.
philosophy: One day, today's ordinary moments will be the memories we treasure.
ctaTitle: Where does your family's story begin?
ctaDescription: A name, a photograph, a little moment worth remembering. Begin with what feels close to you.
footerNote: Keep your people close. Keep their stories.
seoDescription: Connect generations and preserve your family's story with MyLife: family trees, timelines, anniversaries, photo albums, and the places that bring us together.
